newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Deroma H1 sales rise 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Deroma H1 sales rise 13 pct.

text.p: Italian terracotta pot maker Deroma Holding said its first half 1997 turnover rose 13 percent to 85 billion lire and announced new investments totalling 13 billion lire by mid-1998.

The Vicenza-based company, which was listed on the Milan Bourse in March, said in a statement the investments would be used to build a new production plant to be operational from May next year and which will guarantee an increase in output of some 20 million pots per year.
Deroma said first half sales rose nine percent in Italy, by 29 percent in North America and by 30 percent in the rest of the world.
Deroma shares started 2.16 percent up at 10,250 lire on a generally firmer Milan stock market.
